title: Instagram not meant to create panic: Karnataka HC refuses relief to doctor who claimed Nandini products were toxic
description: The Karnataka High Court on Monday declined to stay criminal proceedings initiated against a Bengaluru-based dermatologist accused of spreading misinformation about Nandini dairy products through Instagram reels [Dr Sharanya Padma Vs State of Karnataka].Social media cannot be used to create public panic without scientific basis, said Justice M Nagaprasanna while refusing to grant interim relief to the accused doctor on her plea to quash the criminal case against her.
